title: Mountain Bike, card A: snappy bars
kaylee: The bike answers her finger at once: push and it carves across the trail, Maple leans and crouches into it, leaves fly and the wheel leaves a line. Let go and she rides straight on.
questions: Does it feel as quick as Bottomless now (yes, closer, or no)?
Should a turn cost a little speed (keep or drop)?

pictures.title: Same pushes, before and after (0.6 s a frame)
pictures.caption: Before, the bike drifted toward a spot and the camera stayed on the trail. Now it carves across, Maple leans hard into it and the camera swings behind her.
